from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1 and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1 and grid[0][c] in (0, 4))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    lbg = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rbg = Counter(x for row in right for x in row if x != lbg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if x != lbg else (0 if y == 0 else rbg) for x,y in zip(a,b)] for a,b in zip(left,right)]
